title: Hogi Na Inteha Koi
body:
hogi na inteha koi is inteha ke baad
sajda na kar saka koi phir karbala ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ke sar pe rakh ke dastaar shaah ye bole
ek aur karbala hai is karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam kiya lahoo ka aankhon se zindagi bhar
na aisa matami hai zainulliba ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise tamache khaaye baba ke baad us ne
soyi nahi sakina phir karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri laash pe aaun kaise batao akbar
aata nazar nahi hai teri qaza ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nida e khaaliq meri raza ke maalik
mai karbala se pehle tu karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai jis tarha se ghar fatema ka shahid
ujda na koi aise aale abaa ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
author: Shahid
